text_html:
Spent a good part of the day working on this to adapt what ale-5000 started for a generic MicroG flashable zip, and get it to work as a nice universal installer for all arch types. And make changes to update all apps within the scripts, fix releases, nightlies, etc.
Check the releases if you want to help test.
https://github.com/Bliss-Bass/microg-unofficial-installer
